scope: External clamp retirement, PC24 deactivation correction and portable native timing masks; no new gameplay caller
frame_precision: x87 control word007F (24-bit significand, extended exponent); other original contexts remain separately recorded

rules.name: offset-correction
rules.operation: weighted/frequency - lastInput + priorOffset, round at each PC24 register operation and store once; missing lastInput skips correction

rules.name: cold-retirement
rules.expected: Positive retirement keeps uninitialized timing; first manager update initializes offset and anchors start/end before checking expiry.

rules.name: retained-pose
rules.expected: NI5 can become NI3 while preserving destination frame and captured sample; keep pose until NI0, then clear it.

rules.name: immediate-cancel
rules.expected: Nonpositive duration or C4-forced zero makes NI0 without requiring a first manager update; partial pose initialization remains stored.

rules.name: cached-start
rules.expected: Cached activation can reset offset/easeStart while retaining lastInput/weighted/output. Do not reject these masks or replace them with zero history.

rules.name: large-first-manager
rules.expected: A positive duration can round its stop to the first clock. Initialize offset and retirement clocks, then become inactive before updating input/output.
